origin.source: Real @modelcontextprotocol/sdk: an McpServer over stdio with start, status, and send tools

comparison.purpose: A coding agent works through a bug-fix machine over MCP. start returns the workflow from describeMachine; status lists the events the agent may send, from getAcceptedEvents with actor: "agent"; send parses the payload at the boundary and reports an ignored event. Review events are tagged meta: { actor: "human" }, so only the host's own UI sends them.
